title.en: An Act to Amend Certain Items for the Province of La Union Subsection (a), Title E, Section One Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred Twenty
title.orig: An Act to Amend Certain Items for the Province of La Union Subsection (a), Title E, Section One Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred Twenty
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Điều 1 của Đạo luật Cộng hòa số 920
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมมาตรา 1 แห่งพระราชบัญญัติแห่งสาธารณรัฐที่ 920

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1157_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Items (d) and (e) of Group I and items (f), (g) and (i) of Group II for the province of La Union, subsection (a), Title E, section one, Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred twenty, are amended to read as follows:
"(d) For the construction of an artesian well, including an elevated take in the poblacion of San Juan ₱10,000.00 "(e) For the construction of the communal irrigation system in the barrio of Cabaroan, Bacnota 10,000.00 "(f) For the construction of the communal irrigation system in the barrio of Cadacian, San Fernand 6,000.00 "(f-1) For the repair of the communal irrigation system in the barrio of Tanquigan, San Fernand 1,000.00 "(g) For the repair and improvement of the Bangar-Sengat Castro road, in Bangar and Sudipe 5,000.00 "(i) For the construction of the communal irrigations system in the barrio of Guinabang, Bacnota 26,000.00

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1954.
